reason: Replace target-driven capacity projection and two-state replay with explicit decisions, construction queues, fuel stocks and feedback.
evidence_boundary: The earlier holdout has already been inspected. All new model selection and comparisons are development evidence, not a new blind test.

annual.additional_observation_note: Separate publication vintage; no observed 2025 CO2 in the saved data.

hourly.information_contract: Identical finite forecast, initial physical state, arrivals and weather; execute first decisions and update the true physical state.
hourly.profile_boundary: Synthetic chronological engineering experiments, not observed national hourly events or a probability model.

inventory_policy_experiment.reason: Expose depletion and protection thresholds explicitly; a 30-day event need not exhaust the baseline 45-day buffer.
inventory_policy_experiment.boundary: Engineering reserve alternatives, not measured national inventories or risk probabilities. Report resource use and holding-cost assumptions separately.

posthoc_forecast_diagnostic.boundary: Added after observing reserve-cohort failures. Longer forecasts provide stronger information to both policies, not a pure algorithm gain. Keep the main 24h cohort unchanged.

reporting.carbon_neutrality: Report residual emissions and required removals; no assumed capture fraction is treated as installed capture capacity.
reporting.software_scope: State which policies actually execute in MATLAB/Simulink; do not call a distinct native demonstration rule the Python MPC.
